Job description

 Social Impact \& Sustainability

41737
**Who You Are**
* You are currently pursuing a PhD at an Australian university, reside in Australia, and have an anticipated graduation date after September 2027\.

**Who We Are**
Dolby’s Advanced Technology Group in Sydney creates cutting\-edge audio, video, and multimodal technologies that drive next\-generation experiences.
Our interests are broad \- interactive media using Machine Learning/AI, data science of media, cloud implementations of media processing and delivery, and explorations of audio\-video content creation for immersive media such as XR.
**What’s Involved**
* We will work with you and your PhD supervisor to define a project that relates to your PhD, such that successful completion is not delayed by the internship
* You will then spend four months with Dolby Australia researchers investigating a cutting\-edge topic
* We highly encourage publication of the results of your project in an appropriate conference or journal
* You will have the opportunity to work with a diverse global network of Dolby researchers, scientists and creators, and gain a solid understanding of industry\-based research
* This is a paid internship based in our Sydney office, running from May to September 2027\. Relocation support is available for those based outside of Sydney.

**Technical Background**
* AI / Machine learning systems, preferably with application to audio, video, text, and multimedia
* Human\-computer interfaces and AI applications
* Multimodal / cross\-modal representation learning
* Trustworthy and explainable AI
* Generative AI for media creation
* Spatial computing for 6DoF multimedia
* Multimodal and immersive audio and video creation
* 3D deep learning (including NeRF, Gaussian Splatting, etc.)

**Example Project Areas**
* Live events or sports
* Data provenance, attribution, and authenticity
* Controllable generation of audio, video, textual, or multimedia content
* Multimodal experience creation
* Future devices (e.g., smart glasses and holographic displays)
* Next\-generation entertainment experiences in automotive

These points are examples. We are actively looking for new ideas, and if your research project does not fall precisely in the above categories, please still consider applying. For example, if you are doing a PhD in quantum computing algorithms with AI or a project that involves user interfaces with robots or Internet of Things applications \- come tell us about it, because we are flexible!
**Skills and Specialty Areas**
We are interested in PhD research candidates from Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Science, Music Technology, Media Technology, or Media Content Creation.
We are not prescriptive of skill sets, but it is useful if the research intern has ability in using appropriate tools e.g., a project in machine learning may require programming in Python or MATLAB, or a project in XR creation may use Max/MSP or Final Cut / Logic Pro.
Most importantly, we are looking for the ability to creatively explore and design experiments to uncover new and interesting learnings in media.

We do this by striving to create an inclusive environment where everyone feels welcome to be who they are—with the freedom to exchange ideas, think innovatively, and listen to each other and customers in meaningful ways. As a global leader in ratings and integrated risk assessment, we’re advancing AI to move from insight to action—enabling intelligence that not only understands complexity but responds to it. We decode risk to unlock opportunity, helping our clients navigate uncertainty with clarity, speed, and confidence.


If you are excited about this opportunity but do not meet every single requirement, please apply! You still may be a great fit for this role or other open roles. We are seeking candidates who model our values: invest in every relationship, lead with curiosity, champion diverse perspectives, turn inputs into actions, and uphold trust through integrity.

* Driven and motivated and eager to learn
* Communicates clearly in writing and speech; adapts style for clients and internal teams; confident on calls and in meetings
* Analyses and matches data with strong attention to detail using spreadsheets and basic formulas
* Plans and prioritizes tasks; meets deadlines across multiple projects; comfortable working to weekly goals and metrics
* Can undertake thorough research through use of different tools – including AI, to help research organizations and decision\-makers; builds accurate prospect lists; experience with a customer relationship system preferred

Lead the University’s central Work Health and Safety (WHS) function by providing leadership, governance, and continuous improvement of all aspects of the University’s WHS Program, Injury Management and Return to Work Program, and Workers Compensation insurance and claims management.* **Salary up to $185,000 plus 17% superannuation**
* **Full\-time continuing role (HEW Level 10, Band 1\)**
* **Macquarie University, Wallumattagal Campus, North Ryde**

 ***A rare breadth of WHS: research, health, science and higher education on a single campus***

  

Macquarie University is looking for an experienced work health and safety professional to lead our central WHS function. As **Head of Workplace Health and Safety**, you will guide the framework, systems and team that keep more than 10,000 staff, students, contractors and visitors physically and psychologically safe across a busy campus that includes research laboratories, teaching spaces, hospital and health facilities, commercial entities and outdoor operations.

  

This is a genuinely broad portfolio. You will set the WHS strategy for the University and its Controlled Entities, oversee injury management and workers compensation, act as the trusted adviser to senior leaders on complex safety matters, and translate WHS performance data into clear reporting for University Council, committees and boards. It is a role where governance rigour and practical, people\-centred judgement matter in equal measure.

  

Reporting to the Chief Risk Officer and working within the Group Risk portfolio, you will join a team that is trusted, well supported and closely connected to executive decision\-making. If you enjoy improving systems, developing capable teams and seeing the real\-world results of a mature safety culture, this is an opportunity to make a visible contribution at scale.

 **About the Role**

  

Working as part of the Group Risk portfolio within the Office of the Vice\-President, Finance and Resources, you will oversee the University's WHS Program, Injury Management and Return to Work Program, and workers compensation insurance and claims management.

  

Your responsibilities will include:

  

* Setting and delivering the Group WHS strategy across the University and its Controlled Entities, strengthening safety culture and enabling continuous improvement.
* Ensuring due diligence and compliance with the NSW WHS Act, Regulations and Codes of Practice.
* Guiding and developing a team of eight WHS, injury management, emergency management and hazardous materials specialists.
* Owning the University's WHS framework (policies, procedures, training, systems, reporting and performance management) to protect physical and psychological health and safety.
* Delivering complex, cross\-functional WHS programs and projects, managing scope, risk and stakeholder alignment.
* Managing the WHS operating budget.
* Advising senior leaders on WHS and rehabilitation matters, balancing better\-practice approaches with statutory obligations and operational realities.
* Overseeing injury management, workers compensation, return to work and early intervention, including external provider relationships, to improve outcomes and reduce harm and cost.
* Overseeing WHS consultation and governance and translating WHS analytics into clear reporting for University Council, committees and boards.
* Managing regulator engagement and reporting (for example SafeWork NSW), and required registrations and permits with CASA, the ATO and the Commonwealth Department of Health, Disability and Ageing.

  

Please note that work hours may vary from time to time to accommodate business needs, such as after\-hours incident response or notification of regulators.

Macquarie University is a place of vibrant and connected communities, where new ideas are welcomed and where people are encouraged to see things differently. Ranked among Australia's leading universities for research and teaching, we sit on a single, park\-like campus in Sydney's north that brings together researchers, students, health services, commercial partners and a thriving precinct.

 **About You (Selection Criteria)**

description_text:
An exciting opportunity for a Teaching \& Leadership or Teaching \& Research academic to develop and contribute to innovative and impactful teaching in the Doctor of Physiotherapy and other Health Sciences courses.  

  

* Salary Package: Level B from $127,138 to $150,425 p.a. or Level C from $155,236 to $178,523 plus 17% employer’s superannuation and annual leave loading
* Appointment Type: Full\-time, 2\-year fixed term appointment
* Located at Macquarie University (Wallumattagal Campus, North Ryde)

**The Role**


Macquarie University is proud to offer a highly respected, innovative and evidenced\-based Doctor of Physiotherapy (DPT) post graduate degree and is seeking a **Lecturer or Senior Lecturer** to join our dedicated and ambitious Physiotherapy team. Our course combines contemporary coursework with over 1,000 hours of supervised clinical placements, providing students with an excellent grounding for their future career.  



  

Reporting to the Head of School, Health Sciences and Nursing, and Course Director of Physiotherapy, you will utilise your professional and industry experience to make a critical contribution to the development and delivery of teaching within the DPT program and other Health Sciences courses. We seek a highly motivated and collaborative physiotherapist to join our School for appointment to either the Teaching and Leadership or Teaching and Research job family. You will have expertise in teaching and convening Physiotherapy and Health Sciences related programs, and research in these areas.

  

The Macquarie University Academic Job Family Framework recognises and rewards the breadth of academic work.

  

The Teaching \& Leadership Academic is a specialist teaching and leadership role for academic staff who demonstrate excellence in teaching and leadership. As a specialist role, Teaching \& Leadership Academic staff dedicate their workload contribution to Teaching, Teaching Leadership, and Service. Graduate research degree supervision may also form a part of teaching\-related activities in this job family.

  

The Teaching \& Research Academic dedicates their workload contribution to teaching, research and service including graduate research student supervision within their research as well as fulfilling service roles to the School and/or Faculty.

 **About Us**


The Faculty of Medicine, Health and Human Sciences (FMHHS) is ambitiously pushing the boundaries of progressive thinking and challenging what’s possible to solve some of the big issues of our time, both nationally and on a global scale.

  

The faculty’s current education suite includes courses in clinical science, physiotherapy, medicine and public health, psychology, cognitive sciences, linguistics, audiology, and speech pathology. The Faculty forms part of Macquarie University Health, an integrated academic health sciences enterprise which incorporates Macquarie University Hospital and primary and speciality clinics. We have active research programs in neurosciences, health systems and patient safety research, cancer medicine, and clinical sciences, amongst others.

  

We foster a values\-based culture of innovation and creativity to achieve excellence in teaching and to enhance the research performance of the University. We invest in developing the careers and wellbeing of our students and staff and expect all our leaders to live our values of Caring, Integrity, Teamwork, Ambition, Innovation, and Engagement.

 **To Apply**


To be considered for this position, please apply online by submitting your CV and a separate (2\-page maximum) cover letter that demonstrates how you meet the following selection criteria:

 **About You**


You will possess a tertiary qualification in physiotherapy and be interested in sharing your professional experience to make a critical contribution to the development and delivery of learning and teaching within the DPT and other health sciences courses. You will have experience with, or a willingness to embrace, educational technology, blended learning and educational innovation. In addition, ideally you will be able to demonstrate an understanding of the integration between research/practice and quality teaching, and how this integration can enhance student engagement.

 ***Essential Criteria***

* Tertiary qualification in Physiotherapy, including a PhD.
* Current registration with the Physiotherapy Board of Australia (AHPRA).
* Demonstrated academic and professional expertise in physiotherapy and/or health sciences, with capacity to teach into at least one or more areas (musculoskeletal, neurological and/or cardiorespiratory) relevant to the Doctor of Physiotherapy program.
* Demonstrated experience delivering high\-quality learning and teaching, including the design, delivery and management of lectures, tutorials, assessments and online learning.
* Demonstrated excellent interpersonal and communication skills, with the ability to work effectively in a collegial and/or multidisciplinary team environment and foster an inclusive learning experience for students.
* Demonstrated success in academic leadership in the delivery and/or development of units or courses using innovative teaching approaches, with evidence of positive outcomes **(Level C)**.
* Evidence of advanced clinical practice experience relevant to physiotherapy education **(Level C)**.

 ***Desirable Criteria***

* Experience teaching into professionally accredited programs.
* Demonstrated contribution to physiotherapy education through curriculum development, educational innovation, leadership or professional engagement.
* Demonstrated experience in clinical and/or teaching and/or research in areas of neurological rehabilitation or geriatrics or paediatrics physiotherapy in an academic setting.

  

\*\*\****The successful candidate will be required to complete a Police Check and an academic qualification check and hold current AHPRA registration, which is also subject to verification.***

Prince of Wales Hospital and Community Health Service is a Level 6 Tertiary Referral Hospital with an inpatient bed base of 370\. POWH offers an outpatient service and rural outreach service and provides more than 900,000 occasions of non\-admitted patient care each year, including innovative virtual models of care. We have transitioned the majority of inpatient units and wards to the Acute Services Building (ASB) including a state of the art Emergency Department and Intensive Care Unit. * Qualifications in accordance with Schedule C of the NSW Health Service Health Professionals (State) Award and the Physiotherapy Board of Australia (AHPRA).


* Extensive post graduate clinical experience in Aged Care Physiotherapy and demonstrated core competency skills in Musculoskeletal, Neurological and Cardiorespiratory Physiotherapy


* Excellent negotiation, decision making and advocacy skills including the ability to interact constructively and collaboratively with a diverse range of stakeholders, throughout all organisational levels.


* Ability to provide in\-depth advice and education to enhance service delivery and to guide and support others in providing service excellence, with the capacity to provide clinical supervision to other staff.

Are you an experienced scrub/scout nurse with a passion for cardiac and vascular surgery? Macquarie University Hospital is seeking a skilled Registered Nurse to join our Theatre department on a full\-time, permanent basis. This is an outstanding opportunity to be part of a highly specialised surgical team within Australia's only university\-owned academic hospital, where clinical excellence, innovation and professional growth go hand in hand.

 **About the Role**

  

In this role, you will support cardiothoracic and vascular surgeries as a scrub/scout nurse, playing an essential part in ensuring procedures are conducted smoothly and safely. Your key responsibilities will include:

* Preparing and setting up surgical instruments and specialised equipment for cardiac, vascular and thoracic procedures.
* Performing preoperative safety checks and ensuring compliance with perioperative standards and protocols.
* Providing skilled scrub and scout support to the surgical team throughout procedures.
* Maintaining accurate documentation and contributing to clinical governance and quality improvement initiatives.
* Collaborating effectively with the multidisciplinary surgical team to deliver safe, high\-quality patient care.
* Participating in on\-call duties as part of our commitment to providing 24/7 surgical support. Flexibility and responsiveness are essential, as on\-call duties are a critical component of ensuring emergency and after\-hours care.

  

Extensive training and orientation will be provided to the successful candidate to support your transition into the role and ongoing development within our specialised surgical program.

 **About Us**

  

Macquarie University Health is a trailblazer in healthcare, education and research. Australia's first and only fully integrated academic health sciences centre brings together Macquarie University Hospital, Clinics and the Faculty of Medicine, Health and Human Sciences at Macquarie University. We foster a collegiate environment and hold a deep commitment to diversity, equity and inclusion.
